description: This Java class implements the GeoLocation interface to provide geolocation services based on IP addresses using the MaxMind GeoIP database. It loads a GeoLite2 database resource, looks up city and country information, and populates an Address object.

classes.name: GeoLocationImpl
classes.description: Implementation of geolocation functionality using MaxMind's GeoIP2 database, capable of resolving an IP address to geographical information stored in Address objects.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an Address object populated with geographic data (country, postal code, zone, city) for a provided IP address.
